sum: Aya Gold & Silver Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of precious metals projects in Morocco. The company primarily explores for gold and silver deposits. Its flagship project holds 100% interests in the Zgounder property located east of Agadir in the Proterozoic Siroua Massif of the Anti-Atlas Range, Morocco covering an area of approximately 378 square kilometers. It has acquired strategic exploration portfolio comprising three mining licenses and 18 exploration permits covering approximately 259 km² of land across three distinct exploration projects located in Morocco. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mount Royal, Canada.
ceo: Mr. Benoit  La Salle CPA, F.C.A., FCPA, M.B.A. (President, CEO & Director)
